decisions.statement: A game announces only the words it names here.
The system window reports what is so and never judges, foretells, or tells a scene.
An announcement reads the same whoever it happens to.
What an announcement felt like belongs to the prose rather than to the window.
An announcement says where a thing now is rather than where that thing was.
The value an announcement shows is the value the sheet shows for that thing.

definition: a word the system window announces to a player of this game
